articles.title: Chaos gets a visual upgrade!
articles.summary: Distinct effects, clearer status icons and formation previews across all 35 Chaos buffs.
articles.body:
Chaos buffs now have distinct status symbols, movement trails, transformation cues and deployment effects. Crown halos, parachutes and new prop art make each resolved action easier to follow.

Track quest milestones, recruitment readiness and the Kingless countdown in the match HUD. Preview your formation before confirming it, with clear legal landing markers for supported tactical powers. Reduced Motion and effect preferences remain available.

These changes are integrated for Practice and Multiplayer Chaos. Online availability depends on the updated server and game build.

articles.title: Kingdom and Shadow - A collection inspired by Kingdom Rush!
articles.summary: Linirea and Veznan step onto the chessboard with a new fantasy 3D look.
articles.body:
Denas and Veznan represent two sides of this Kingdom Rush-inspired collection: the green waters of Linirea and the scorched ruins of a darker kingdom. Piece models, board art and environments have presentation data in the repository. This article does not announce a live event or free rewards.

Project artwork and models were contributed by Tofu. This is inspired content, not an official Ironhide partnership. The article stays behind an editorial rights gate until the project owner clears public distribution and any commercial use.

articles.title: Chaos Mode: all 35 buffs are now in the online codebase!
articles.summary: A full set of unusual powers has been connected to the online Chaos system.
articles.body:
All 35 Chaos buffs have been synchronized between the online system and the local practice rules in source. Tiered draft cards help distinguish the powers that can change the course of a match.

This milestone adds the Chaos v3 protocol and headless checks for the buff flow. It is a verified development update: availability still depends on the deployed backend and the player build. Headless checks do not replace an actual two-player online playtest.

articles.title: Shop V2 - More ways to use Gold and Diamonds!
articles.summary: The cosmetic shop is connected to your account wallet.
articles.body:
Shop V2 connects cosmetic offers to the Gold and Diamonds in your account wallet. Purchases, ownership checks and equipment use server data so your items can move into your collection consistently.

This source update focuses on the shop experience and wallet consistency. It does not announce real-money top-ups, discounts or limited-time offers. The available catalog depends on backend configuration and the game build you are running.

articles.title: Custom chess pieces - A lineup that feels like yours
articles.summary: Choose your pieces and preview their models before a match.
articles.body:
The loadout flow adds a clearer way to preview chess models before entering a match. You can see how a set will look and prepare choices that fit the items in your collection.

This source milestone expands cosmetic presentation and match preparation. Equipment still follows actual ownership and catalog rules. Reading this article does not unlock an item or change the rules of chess.

articles.title: Ranked play and matchmaking expand
articles.summary: Find an opponent with a clearer matchmaking flow.
articles.body:
Ranked play and matchmaking have been expanded in source, with a clearer waiting flow while an online match is being prepared. The goal is to make the next step easier to follow while finding an opponent.

This update covers game modes and matchmaking infrastructure. It does not announce a ranked season, ranked rewards or a tournament schedule. Actual online availability depends on the deployed server.

articles.title: A refreshed Play, Loadout and Match Dialog flow
articles.summary: A smoother route into your next match with fewer extra steps.
articles.body:
The Play, Loadout and match dialog flow has been adjusted so match preparation follows a clearer sequence. Choices before a match are organized to reduce unnecessary steps and make the next action easier to find.

This is a small refinement after the first milestone in the curated news history. Its interface changes are verified against the linked commit. No event or additional reward system is announced here.

articles.title: Settings grows to six tabs with better accessibility
articles.summary: Organized settings and a live preview make adjustments easier.
articles.body:
Settings is organized into six tabs to make options easier to find. A live preview helps you see the effect of changes while adjusting the game, alongside improvements to accessibility.

Explore the tabs and compare your adjustments in the preview before returning to your next match. This development update brings a more organized place to tune the experience to your preferences.
